name: Sarvam: Bulbul V2
description:
Sarvam: Bulbul V2 is a text-to-speech (TTS) model from Sarvam AI, delivering real-time, natural-sounding speech in 11 Indian languages at a fraction of global costs.
It builds on prior versions with key enhancements including improved audio quality, 30+ speaker voices (expanded from six distinct voices in v1 for diverse use cases like professional or conversational tones), and adjustable speech speed from 0.5x to 2.0x for customized delivery.
